artworks.title: Title Page with Fountain
artworks.medium: etching with graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring a large rock formation slightly off-center. The rock is detailed with textures through fine lines. Inscriptions are visible on the rock's surface. Trees frame the scene on either side of the rock, with swirling strokes for leaves and fine lines for trunks and branches. The horizon line is below the rock, depicted by grassy terrain. The sky shows delicate horizontal lines suggesting clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray.

artworks.title: Title Page with Fountain
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a stone structure extending into the middle. The stone wall dominates the upper portion, appearing unfinished or partially destroyed. The brushstrokes resemble fine, detailed etching lines. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of black lines against a creamy background. Trees frame the scene, with clouds lightly etched in the sky.

artworks.title: Dog and Cat
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows two dogs lying on the ground. The drawing uses stark contrasts and heavy cross-hatching to depict the scene. The intricate line work emphasizes the fur of the dogs, capturing their forms in a detailed yet somewhat abstract manner. Strong shadows and highlights are present, suggesting a somber ambiance. The composition gives a sense of tranquility and stillness to the image.

artworks.title: Two Asses
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two donkeys standing near a building. The image depicts two donkeys standing closely together on a patch of ground. Behind them stands a rustic building with a partially open window. A vine climbs up part of the building. In the background, there is a faint depiction of a landscape with an additional animal.

artworks.title: Two Carts
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a winding path, scattered trees, structures like a thatched-roof house, and horse-drawn carts. In the distance, there is a castle or large building complex with a tower on a hill. Mountains dominate the skyline. The black and white etching technique creates detailed textures and depth. The sky is filled with linear patterns.

artworks.title: Three Cottages
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a rustic scene with various natural and man-made elements. The horizon is high in the image, aligned with the tree tops creating a natural wall. To the left, a building with a steep roof is partially visible above dense foliage. Two figures are walking on a dirt path winding around weathered wooden structures that resemble sheds or barns. Planks and smaller branches are scattered about. The scene is depicted with fine, meticulous brushstrokes, detailing textures of trees, leaves, and wooden surfaces. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on shades of tan and brown, creating a warm, sepia-toned quality.

artworks.title: Three Cottages
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a rural scene with a humble setting. The view is slightly elevated, showing the surroundings. There are trees on the horizon, with a building partially concealed by them. Two figures are walking on a path in the foreground. The etching shows detailed texture and ruggedness in the landscape and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on form and detail. The composition conveys a rustic and tranquil atmosphere, emphasizing rural simplicity.

artworks.title: The Knoll
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed etched scene depicting a lush landscape with a cabin nestled among trees. The horizon is not clearly defined, with intricate details of foliage, rocks, and the cabin. The artwork utilizes fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth, with a monochromatic color palette. Figures and rock formations are present, adding human elements to the serene environment. The scene is framed by trees and branches, creating a dramatic composition.

artworks.title: Large Rock
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image features an etching showing an outdoor scene with rocky formations, trees, and a low horizon. The artwork utilizes fine lines to depict textures such as rocks, foliage, and clouds. A figure is seated on a rock in the foreground. In the distance, there are trees, a small building, and a dirt path leading further into the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, typical of etchings, creating depth and contrast through line variations.

artworks.title: Large Rock
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration viewed from a low angle. Jagged rock formations are prominent on the left, with more landscape extending into the distance on the right. A small wooden structure is seen among trees on the right, leading to a pathway or riverbank. The illustration uses fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture, particularly in the rocks, trees, and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, highlighting details with varying shades of black and white. In the lower left corner, a seated figure is surrounded by lush vegetation and detailed trees.

artworks.title: The Steeple
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with an old church amidst greenery. The viewpoint is at eye level, showing a wide perspective of the scene. The church's steeple rises on the left side, with detailed lines conveying textures across the landscape. The artwork is done using an etching or engraving technique, and the color scheme is sepia or brown ink on lighter paper. A path leads towards the church, with two figures approaching it, and another figure sits to the right. Trees surround the church, and mountains are visible in the background, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Boulder in the Woods
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The view is from a lower angle, focusing on a large tree canopy dominating the left side of the composition. The background shows a dense forest with tall trees reaching up to the sky. The image is created with detailed lines, hatching, and cross-hatching for texture and depth. It has a monochromatic color palette of black and white, accentuating the details of the foliage and terrain. The scene fades into the distance with the sky partly obscured by leafy branches overhead.

artworks.title: Pilgrim with a Dog
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a log cabin surrounded by trees and natural elements. A winding path leads towards the cabin where a figure with a dog is walking. The horizon is hidden by trees and the cabin, creating a sense of intimacy. The technique seems to be an etching with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on light and shadow. More trees are visible in the distance, enhancing the secluded environment.

artworks.title: Wheel underneath the Hay Barn
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic rural scene depicted from a slightly aerial viewpoint. The rooftops of the structures are visible, with the horizon high in the background. Trees, tall poles, and a thatched roof dwelling are depicted. The etching technique is used to capture textures such as the thatched roof and tree foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and sepia to create depth and detail through light and shadow. A dirt path winds from the bottom left corner towards the center, where a small figure is walking, surrounded by trees and rustic buildings.

artworks.title: Cottage with Two Ladders
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, showing trees, structures, and a half-timbered building with a thatched roof. Two figures sit beside logs, and three pigs are nearby. In the distance, two smaller buildings are visible. The artwork features detailed etched lines, cross-hatching for shading, and a monochromatic color palette in shades of brown.

artworks.title: Firs in the Defile
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape view from an elevated perspective. The scene includes rocky terrain with dense clusters of trees. Close to us, there are detailed rocks and foliage showing various textures through etching. The horizon features a building on a steep hill or cliff. The etching lines create intricate patterns defining the textures of rocks, trees, and clouds. The monochrome color palette emphasizes contrast and depth. The background shows a sky with low-lying, rounded clouds.

artworks.title: Shepherd with Lamb
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, clusters of trees, a shepherd with a sheep, a figure sitting on a hill, grazing sheep near water, tall trees, and a structure. The artwork is created using an etching technique with delicate lines, featuring a monochromatic color palette of sepia and black.

artworks.title: Two Horsemen on a Rocky Path
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a cityscape in the distance. There are rugged rocks, vegetation, and travelers on a path. The artwork features fine, intricate lines with cross-hatching creating texture. The color palette is primarily black and white, emphasizing contrast. The composition leads the eye from the foreground to the backgrounds, creating depth.

artworks.title: Man on a Small Wooden Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic scene with natural elements and structures. The viewpoint is at eye level, showing a wooden building in the center, surrounded by rocks, trees, and dense foliage. The horizon is not clearly visible, with trees and foliage obscuring the view. The artistic technique features detailed, linear brushstrokes typical of engraving, emphasizing texture in the natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black lines on a light background. Rocks are scattered in the foreground, with lush vegetation and trees extending towards the sky. Wispy branches and lightly rendered clouds are also visible in the background.

artworks.title: River at the Foot of a High Rock
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic landscape with a large rocky hill in the center. Wooden buildings are situated on top of the hill. The horizon is high, showing terrain and structures in detail. The etching style uses fine lines and hatching for textures on the rock face and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia and black tones. A body of water reflects parts of the scene with small figures and boats. In the distance, another building with a pointed roof is visible on an elevated terrain.

artworks.title: Pointed Boulder at the Bank of a River
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with natural and man-made elements. A wooden structure is seen among trees on the left, with elaborate branches extending towards the center. The horizon shows clouds in the sky. The composition is detailed with fine lines while distant textured rock formations are visible surrounded by foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white, emphasizing linear details. The ground is densely vegetated, and two figures stand by a calm body of water on the right with a docked boat nearby.

artworks.title: Hut with the Remains of a Hedge
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon line is high, with rolling hills, trees, and a distant building to the left. The sky has wispy clouds. The etching style is detailed, showing textures of foliage and earth. A path winds through the scene with scattered branches and logs. A man walks towards a small structure on the right. The scene is in monochrome, emphasizing contrast and textures. In the distance, figures, including a person on horseback, add scale and life to the composition.

artworks.title: Berkenrode Castle
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a building complex resembling a large house or small castle with multiple sections and chimneys. The perspective is straight on, capturing the entire facade of the structure. The horizon is high above the rooftops, with birds flying in the sky. The clouds are delicately etched. The strokes show detailed texture of the bricks, foliage of trees, and ripples of water on the right. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black. Two figures in period attire are near the building. Trees frame the composition, with detailed vegetation and small animals visible on the left. A footbridge spans a section of water to the right, leading to the house.

artworks.title: Ruins of Assemburg Castle
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in memory of Charles B. Hoyt
artworks.description: The etching depicts a pastoral landscape with a castle, church tower, trees, and a man with a walking stick. The scene is detailed with fine lines, featuring a monochromatic color palette. The bottom of the image includes Dutch text.
